Accuracy check with synthetic signals

Generates 15-second, 500 Hz test signals with a known heart rate from 40 to 180 BPM, three pulse shapes, with and without added noise and baseline drift, and compares what this analyzer measures with the true rate. A result counts as correct when it is within 2.5 BPM.
